10x v2 VIS (ABC atlas), Pvalb | DC1 x DC2 | n 9137 | k 25 | k/n 0.27% (k/n flag: 10x k 25 is the K1 plateau k nearest 1.3%; Smart-seq is at 2.58%) | bandwidth 0.90 old bin widths (DC1 2.25e-04, DC2 1.70e-04) | types set aside: 0733 Pvalb chandelier Gaba_1 (native cluster) 260 cells (details: types, walls, notes)This is a projection, not the landscape: each surface value averages cells of different basins that land near that point in 2-D, so walls in 50-D can vanish or smear, and kernel smoothing makes basins look shallower and walls lower than the per-cell U. Read heights from the tree. Surface = Gaussian kernel regression (Nadaraya-Watson) of per-cell U (raw D above the lowest cell) on an 80 x 80 grid over the 1st-99th percentile box; bandwidth = the largest grid value whose leave-one-out error is within 3% of the minimum (optimum 0.50, +2.7% LOO error). Colour = height (RdYlBu_r, this surface's min-max).
Cells (all 9137) on the floor below the surface. Dotted drop lines (Basin colouring; one legend click hides them): from the surface down to the floor at each basin's lowest cell (smallest per-cell U), in the basin colour. Heights here are read at a smaller k/n (k 25, n 9,137, 0.27%) than Sst and Vip (k 150, about 1.3%), so heights are not comparable across the three subclasses. Buttons: Basin = L3s basins at k (tree colours; a 10x basin shares a Smart-seq colour only when the two are matched, mutual best cosine >= 0.7; other basins have colours used nowhere else); t-type = Round T mapped Tasic t-type, Tasic AIT29 colours; cells with mapping confidence < 0.8 are one grey group, listed last; Supertype = native ABC supertype, atlas colours (WMB taxonomy 20231215); supertypes with < 20 cells pooled as 'other (< 20)' in grey; sorted by size. Types set aside at stage 1 are not in the landscape and are not drawn. DCs: eigenvalue-scaled diffusion components of the saved embedding, signs as the static poster page; 10x DC4 flipped to match Smart-seq (display only).
